proposals.old_text: urgent: immediate action (system down, blocked workflow, security breach)
proposals.new_text: urgent: immediate action (system down, blocked workflow, security breach, critical data loss)
proposals.hypothesis: Adding 'critical data loss' as an explicit example of 'urgent' helps clarify the boundary between urgent and security/technical issues, reducing overgeneralization of 'urgent'.
proposals.expected_improvement: Reduction in misclassification of technical/security issues as 'urgent' by 15-20% based on trace_ids.
